description: Audit a sitemap: pass a sitemap URL, or a hostname to use the sitemap robots.txt declares. Samples up to 200 listed URLs (evenly across the file; up to 5 children of a sitemap index), fetches each with the stillindexedbot user agent, and flags non-200, redirected, noindex, blocked by robots.txt for Googlebot, and canonicalized elsewhere. Also reports identical and future-dated lastmod values. Takes up to 90 seconds. Separate allowance of 2 audits per IP per hour, not the 60-fetch budget. Same audit as https://stillindexed.com/tools/sitemap-audit.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL, or a hostname (https is assumed).

name: stillindexed_sitemap_audit
